rows.label: tlk43310191_03_msg0001
rows.name:
After what happened in Temperantia,
Superbia is even harder to forgive.

rows.label: tlk43310191_03_msg0002
rows.name:
It was neutral territory, yet they
were secretly excavating a Judician
Divine Beast weapon there!

rows.label: tlk43310191_03_msg0003
rows.name:
The Divine Beast weapon that
wiped out our Temperantia forces
was powerful, certainly...

rows.label: tlk43310191_03_msg0004
rows.name:
But did we really do the
right thing agreeing to
Acedia's calls for a ceasefire?

rows.label: tlk43310191_03_msg0005
rows.name: Did those who fell perish for nothing?
